blocks.text: {{appName}} is provided by {{controllerName}}. You can reach them at {{contactEmail}}.
You accept these terms when you create an account. That includes the guest account the app makes for you when you create or join a group.
You also accept them when you continue with Google.
This is version {{termsVersion}}. When the terms change, the app asks you to accept the new version.
How we handle your data is explained in the [[privacy]]. It is a separate document: you are told about it, not asked to accept it.
{{appName}} gives you shopping lists you can share, prices gathered from supermarkets, and maps of shops. It is free.
We cannot promise that it will always be available.
Prices and photos come from supermarket websites and from people who use the app. They can be wrong or out of date. The price the shop charges you at the till is the one that counts.
Anyone may use {{appName}}. If you are under 14, you need permission from a parent or guardian. The app does not check anyone's age.
Keep your password to yourself.
A guest account lives only on the device where it was made, until you add an email address to it.

items: Copy data from the service with automated tools.
Use the assistant to run up costs, or to make it produce harmful content.

blocks.text: What you write in the app stays yours. You allow us to store it and to show it to the people you share it with.
If you delete your account, what you wrote in a group stays for the other members with your name removed, as the [[privacy]] explains.
The assistant is a program and it makes mistakes. Check what it wrote or changed on your lists.
Each person can use it only a limited amount.
When your voice is turned into text, some words can come out wrong. Read the transcript before you rely on it.
You can delete your account at any time, on the account page.
We can suspend an account that breaks these terms.
We are responsible for the service only as far as the law requires. Nothing in these terms takes away the rights a consumer has under the law of their country.
These terms are governed by the law of the country where {{controllerName}} is established. If you use the service as a consumer, you can always go to the courts where you live.
When we change these terms, the app tells you, and asks you to accept the new version before you go on.
{{appName}} is built on Luna Shopper, which is open source software published under its own licence. These terms cover this service, {{appName}}, and not the software's code.
